tokenizer.encode: UTF-8 bytes mapped one-to-one to IDs; append EOS only between training records or when explicitly requested
tokenizer.decode: IDs 0..255 become bytes and are decoded as UTF-8 with replacement for incomplete sequences; EOS is omitted

architecture.embedding_and_lm_head: exported as separate tensors; may start tied during training but must be duplicated in checkpoint

checkpoint.integrity: SHA-256 recorded in sidecar manifest; Rust loader must verify the supplied expected hash
checkpoint.shape_policy: exact tensor set and exact dimensions; reject missing, unexpected, non-finite, or mismatched tensors

compatibility_limits: This contract matches the current Rust GqaDecoder math, not the external SmolLM2 BPE/SentencePiece tokenizer or checkpoint format.
A successful export proves serialization and shape compatibility only; it does not prove trained-model quality or numerical parity.
The current Rust library exposes tensor primitives and a GQA decoder but still needs a production assembly/loader layer to turn this checkpoint into GqaDecoderWeights.
